Indications:

The salt for acid-base balance. Natrum phosporicum regulates the acid-base balance and is helpful in the treatment of hyperacidity. It assists the metabolism in general and is indicated in digestive complaints like dyspepsia, constipation, flatulence, disorders in digesting fat-rich foods (stomach cramps, obesity), acid reflux, hyperacidity, heartburn, dyspepsia, dizziness, diarrhoea due to hyperacidity, gastroenteritis, diabetes, liver dysfunction, sour eructations, vomiting, nocturnal enuresis or for any other indication, as recommended by your physician.
